lines.t: Thus says The Lord God of Israel,
To the wicked ones stuck in the carousel,
I came down quick, voice stern, no delay,
Proclaimed your error, you gone astray.
Is not My will written in the Book divine?
My decrees made known, every law a sign,
Discernment placed deep, you can choose the way,
Good or evil—life or decay.
What is this I see, day and night?! (whoa-oh)
What is this you’ve chosen, blinded sight?! (whoa-oh)
Hating justice, rage in your soul,
Loathing My promise, losing control.
Blood on your hands, pools on the street,
Sins stacking higher, your judgment complete!
You hate My covenants, despise My name,
My people you mock, My messengers shame.
The widow ignored, the needy dismissed,
The fatherless cry—yet you resist.
You killed the innocent, silenced their breath,
Your feet stand steady in the pools of death.
Sins gather strength, testify in the night,
The stain of death—no hiding from sight!
Behold, a fissure beneath your feet (yeah),
The valley widens, the darkness deep.
Dead bones scattered, dry and gone,
But you keep dancing like nothing’s wrong.
Wailing surrounds, but you don’t hear,
Silence of death is music to your ear.
FALL! The Lord has spoken—FALL!
No more mercy, hear the trumpet call.
Thunder rollin’, lion roarin’,
Generation of slaughter, judgment’s pourin’.
FALL! The Lord has spoken—FALL!
No more mercy, hear the trumpet call.
Thunder rollin’, lion roarin’,
Generation of slaughter, judgment’s pourin’.
The pit is open… the valley wide…
Thus says The Lord…
The pit is open… the valley wide…
Choose this day… life or demise.
